concept:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: photorealistic spacecraft concept design board for BELT RUNNER 3D.
Primary request: redesign the player's small single-pilot mining ship with a memorable, sculpted silhouette and premium realistic materials. It belongs to the same civilian fleet as a rounded ivory-and-graphite cargo carrier. Design a compact, capable working mining craft with flowing compound-curved hull shells, a broad protective shoulder around the cockpit, a tapering rounded nose, and a low continuous keel. Make it distinct from a freighter: nimble, compact, personable, and clearly built for close work around asteroids.

Functional design: a deeply recessed smoked amber wraparound cockpit canopy with visible pilot seat and restrained instrument glow; exactly TWO rear engine bells, held in rounded nacelles integrated into the shoulders of the hull; short swept modular winglets attached at credible standardized wing roots; recessed maneuvering thrusters. A compact articulated circular mining reflector and focusing barrel are mounted BELOW the forward chin on a short protected gimbal, with room to rotate and aim forward. The mining tool must be visibly recognizable as industrial equipment, not a gun turret. Include discreet flush cargo access doors and removable service panels so the ship reads as a miner. One small low dorsal scanner. No long stalks or tall antennas, no large aircraft wings, no weapon racks, no missiles. Preserve believable space for cargo, engines, and cockpit.

Materials: warm ivory painted titanium on the main hull, dark graphite structural undersides and service recesses, restrained ochre trim and small safety markings. Subtle brushed alloy, meaningful fine panel seams, realistic edge wear concentrated near hatches and service areas. Glass should read as glass with depth rather than opaque bronze paint. Pale cyan engine cores, modest red and green navigation lights, restrained bloom. Clear large curved forms come first, engineering detail second; avoid noisy random greebles.

Composition: a polished LANDSCAPE board, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio. One large hero front three-quarter view occupies the upper two-thirds, nose toward the lower right, entire craft visible with comfortable margins. Dark blue-black space with sparse distant asteroids and a soft planetary rim. Bottom strip has two supporting views: rear three-quarter showing both engines clearly, and a closer lower front view revealing the chin mining gimbal and rounded cockpit/hull transition. ALL THREE views must depict exactly the same ship, proportions, winglets, tool mount, and paint layout. Keep the craft visually dominant, with strong readable silhouettes. No dimension diagrams or unrelated ships.

Lighting: physically plausible hard sunlight, soft cool planetary bounce, natural specular highlights that describe the rounded metal, warm cabin light, rich readable shadows. Cinematic path-traced VFX model photography, realistic surface scale and optics.
Text: small tasteful heading "BELT RUNNER 3D" and subtitle "PLAYER MINING SHIP / CONCEPT". No other text, logos, or watermarks.
Avoid: block stacks, boxy side pods, flat triangular slab cockpit, needle nose, long dangling dish stalk, cargo-carrier silhouette, excessive combat styling, toy-like plastic, oversized glowing effects.
textures: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square seamless base-color material scan for a premium civilian mining spacecraft. Full-frame orthographic warm neutral off-white painted titanium skin: broad clean curved-hull-compatible service panel areas, fine narrow dark recessed panel joints, tiny countersunk fasteners, subtle brushed alloy grain, very fine maintenance scratches, restrained wear along panel edges, sparse soft gray smudges. Design the panel layout as continuous flat texture suitable for mapping onto curved hull shells, no depicted spacecraft or 3D rounded object. Fine crisp realistic texture detail without noisy grunge. Mostly near-white neutral paint so the game can tint it to other colors; no large colored stripes. Neutral shadowless diffuse albedo lighting, no specular reflections, no directional shadows, no gradients, no perspective. Tile seamlessly at all four edges. No text, numbers, logos, windows, lights, diagonal hazard stripes or borders.
